description: Vendor-neutral health and execution diagnostics for enabled ITP collectors.

targets.query: WITH latest AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY collector ORDER BY time DESC) AS rn FROM collector_health WHERE collector LIKE ${collector:sqlstring} AND site_id LIKE ${site:sqlstring} AND time >= $__timeFrom AND time <= $__timeTo) SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN success THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Healthy Collectors" FROM latest WHERE rn = 1
